tools.name: search_car_paints
tools.description: Search the FindCarColors catalog by manufacturer, paint name, exact code, or documented model and year examples. Name similarity returns candidates for review.

tools.name: get_paint_details
tools.description: Get sources, finish, code evidence, approximate swatch, and documented examples by stable paint ID or manufacturer and exact catalog code.

tools.description: List paints in the FindCarColors catalog for a manufacturer. Model and year filters use documented examples. Catalog coverage is partial.
